integrity: All equalities for infinitely many dimensions follow from the included written proof; computational enumeration is supporting exact finite evidence. No assertion of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for the standard ambient Euclidean zero-sum embedding of the crown-graph symmetric edge polytope with n at least four. Equivalent graph-spread or metric-polytope descriptions remain an originality risk; finite tests do not establish infinite-dimensional coverage.
title: A sharp Euclidean inradius and tangent-facet transition for crown-graph symmetric edge polytopes
